meta.parties: Silva Et Al. v. Silva Et Al

rules.statement: A purchaser who knew that the vendor had a disputed title and bought the land on speculation is not entitled to recover any more than the price actually paid; he is not entitled to recover damages.
rules.supporting_quote: "For when one knowingly and deliberately buys what does not belong to the seller, he is not to be presumed to have meant to make a gift of the price, but rather to have entertained the hope of acquiring the ownership when the Vendor should acquire it." (Berwick's translation 540.)
